description: Registry of anchor papers with exhaustive annotations for golden dataset validation

anchor_papers.title: Spiking Neural Networks: A Survey
anchor_papers.quality_notes: Comprehensive survey paper with benchmark comparisons across SNN architectures. Good mix of quantitative results and methodology descriptions.
anchor_papers.selection_rationale: Meets all required criteria: open access (arXiv), peer-reviewed equivalent, high claim density (20 claims), covers multiple requirements (REQ-A2.1-4, REQ-B1.1, REQ-B1.4), text extractable, clear structure, published 2022.

anchor_papers.title: Event-Driven Learning for Spiking Neural Networks
anchor_papers.quality_notes: Recent research paper with novel event-driven learning algorithm. Strong quantitative results with hardware deployment validation. Primary focus on energy efficiency.
anchor_papers.selection_rationale: Meets all required criteria: open access (arXiv), peer-reviewed equivalent, high claim density (22 claims), covers multiple requirements (REQ-A2.1-4, REQ-B1.1, REQ-B1.4), text extractable, clear IMRAD structure, published 2024 (recent).

anchor_papers.title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold
anchor_papers.quality_notes: Landmark quantum computing paper demonstrating below-threshold error correction. Excellent quantitative data on qubit counts, gate fidelities, and coherence times. Domain-specific metrics on error suppression factors.
anchor_papers.selection_rationale: Meets all required criteria: open access (arXiv), high impact research, high claim density (18 claims), covers quantum-specific requirements (scalability, energy efficiency), text extractable, clear experimental structure, published 2024 (recent).

anchor_papers.title: CRISPR Genome Editing Using Combined Positive and Negative Selection
anchor_papers.quality_notes: CRISPR methodology paper with clear quantitative metrics on editing efficiency, off-target rates, and cell viability. Good representation of biological assay results and statistical reporting variations common in microbiology.
anchor_papers.selection_rationale: Meets all required criteria: open access (PLOS ONE CC-BY), peer-reviewed, high claim density (16 claims), covers biological safety and reproducibility requirements, text extractable, clear methods/results structure, published 2024.

anchor_papers.title: Sea Level Projections with Machine Learning Using Altimetry and Climate Models
anchor_papers.quality_notes: Climate ML paper with well-characterized uncertainty quantification. Good representation of prediction confidence intervals and model validation. Illustrates domain-specific patterns in climate science reporting.
anchor_papers.selection_rationale: Meets all required criteria: open access (arXiv), high claim density (18 claims), covers environmental impact and prediction accuracy requirements, text extractable, clear methodology, published 2023.
